geo_focused_candidates_pathum_thani_nont.geo_round_summary: Nonthaburi has meaningfully more, and larger, dedicated resale-page competition than Pathum Thani in this sample. HOME888 (120K followers) is now the single largest resale competitor found anywhere in this geo-focused round — nearly 3x Perfect House Property (41K), which was the prior flagship finding — followed by รักบ้าน (25K), both centered on Nonthaburi + the wider ปริมณฑล region. Pathum Thani's largest dedicated page remains far smaller (10K followers) with posting activity that has slowed. Despite HOME888's much larger follower count, its most recently observed post (3 reactions, 1,700 views) shows lower engagement than would be expected from its scale — the strongest reinforcement yet, across this whole project, of the cross-page finding that follower count does not predict engagement.
